name: Aozora Misago
source:
Occupation: housewife

Subjects: Health and Physical Education

Characteristics: The eldest of the Aozora sisters, she does the housework and laundry. She is as patient as her mother and treats the main character as if he were her own son. She is also indifferent to the protagonist's naughty glances.

[From [url=http://mbstruth.com/katei/cha/misa01.html]official site[/url]]
